offers_products.reason: Sells new and pre-owned infusion pumps and disposable supplies like Huber needles, tubing, and Safen tags.

offers_services.reason: Rents pumps, provides biomedical repair and maintenance, and integrated therapy services with nurse patient support.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are hospitals, oncology practices, surgery centers and clinics; patients receive care but providers or payers buy.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Hospitals, oncology practices, surgery centers and home infusion providers buy and rent pumps, supplies and repair services.

recurring_revenue.reason: Largely recurring pump rentals, therapy services, biomedical service contracts and repeat disposable orders from providers.

cyclical_demand.reason: Oncology, pain and wound care infusion and equipment maintenance are medical needs that are hard to postpone.

big_ticket.reason: Mostly rentals, disposables, and routine repair services; small frequent transactions, though some pump sales are larger.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue relies mainly on its 100K+ pump rental fleet and device sales, not mainly staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers include oncology practices, surgery centers and clinics, many small or mid-sized; hospitals are also buyers.

asset_heavy.reason: Maintains and expands a 100K+ device rental fleet plus facilities across the U.S. and Canada.

notes: Mix of device rental, sales and services; large_customers and people_delivered are judgment calls.
